audience: e-commerce sellers and order desks that handle orders, shipments and stock in Apilo

useCases.title: Review orders from a date range
useCases.text: List orders from a date range, filtered by status, payment type or sales channel. Open one order to see its items and delivery address.

useCases.title: Trace the shipments of an order
useCases.text: Read the shipments of an order, then check the carrier tracking status of each shipment.

useCases.title: Check warehouse products and locations
useCases.text: Search warehouse products by SKU, EAN or name. Read the stock quantity and the shelf or bin of each product.

useCases.title: Move an order to a new status
useCases.text: Look up the status ids, change the status of one order, and add an internal note with the reason. The customer does not see the note.

useCases.title: Set the stock quantity of a product
useCases.text: Read the current stock quantity of a product, then set the new quantity. Apilo may push the new quantity to connected marketplaces.

useCases.title: Check accounting documents
useCases.text: List invoices, receipts and corrections by type and invoice date, with numbers, amounts and currency.
